description: Golden question set for the Recall DEMO. Every question and answer is drawn from the fictional sample_notes/ corpus (persona: Sam Carter, owner of a café + roastery). No real personal or business data. The runner (run_eval.py) scores two things per item: (1) RETRIEVAL - did any note whose label contains one of expected_sources get pulled into the sources? (2) ANSWER - does the written answer contain the facts in expected_facts? A fact that is a plain string must appear; a fact that is a list passes if ANY of its options appears (used to allow number formatting or wording variants). Add or edit items freely - this file is the whole quiz.

items.question: What is my emergency fund target?
items.tests: Money - numeric goal about the user ('my')
items.reference: The emergency fund target is 25,000 dollars.

items.question: How much do I set aside each month?
items.reference: 1,200 dollars a month: 800 to the emergency fund, 400 to the second-location fund.

items.question: Which port does the BeanCount loyalty app run on?
items.reference: The BeanCount loyalty app runs on port 5240.

items.question: What port does my home espresso dial-in log run on?
items.reference: The home espresso dial-in log runs on port 5230.

items.question: Who is our head roaster and my mentor?
items.reference: Maria Santos is the head roaster and the owner's mentor.

items.question: Which tool does Dan use to build the staff schedule?
items.reference: Dan builds the staff schedule in Deputy.

items.question: How much Ethiopian coffee do we order each month from Highland?
items.reference: 240 kg of Ethiopian Yirgacheffe from Highland every month.

items.question: What is the minimum order from Verde Importers?
items.reference: Verde Importers' minimum order is 60 kg per lot.

items.question: What time does the café open on Sundays?
items.reference: On Sundays the cafe opens at 8am.

items.question: Why did the espresso machine go down in May?
items.reference: A tripped breaker: a newly added second grinder on the same circuit overloaded it.

items.question: What is our standard espresso shot recipe?
items.reference: 18 g of coffee in, 36 g of espresso out, in about 27 seconds.

items.question: What temperature do we steam milk to?
items.reference: Milk is steamed to 65 degrees Celsius, no hotter.

items.question: What is our pour-over brew ratio?
items.reference: 1 g of coffee to 16 g of water (1:16).

items.question: Around what temperature does first crack start?
items.reference: First crack starts around 196 degrees Celsius.

items.question: Which point-of-sale system does the café use?
items.reference: The cafe uses Square for the till and card payments.

items.question: What year do we hope to open a second café?
items.reference: The goal is to open a second cafe in 2027.

items.question: What process is our decaf?
items.tests: Exact word - a rare process name (added for hybrid search)
items.reference: The decaf is sugarcane process.

items.question: Which importer do we use for decaf?
items.tests: Exact name - supplier name (added for hybrid search)
items.reference: Decaf comes from Verde Importers.

items.question: On what date did the espresso machine die?
items.tests: Exact code - an ISO date (added for hybrid search)
items.reference: The espresso machine died on 2026-05-10.

items.question: What did BeanCount replace?
items.tests: Exact name - made-up product word (added for hybrid search)
items.reference: BeanCount replaced the paper punch cards.

items.question: What does Maria run every week?
items.tests: Exact name - person + a trade term (added for hybrid search)
items.reference: Maria runs the weekly cupping session.

items.question: Who gets flagged when the cash drawer is more than five dollars out?
items.tests: Exact rule lookup - small figure in a process note (added for hybrid search)
items.reference: When the cash drawer is more than five dollars out, it is flagged to Dan.

items.question: How long should roasted beans rest before brewing?
items.tests: Exact number in a reference list (added for hybrid search)
items.reference: Roasted beans rest at least 3 days before brewing.

items.question: At what temperature do we drop a medium roast?
items.tests: Exact number - one of several temperatures in the notes (added for hybrid search)
items.reference: A medium roast is dropped at about 210 degrees Celsius.
